_readme: Surface classification for scripts/skill-coverage.ts. Every exported symbol is reported as public API, advanced public API, generated/type-only, or internal. Public VALUE exports must be mentioned in skills/questpie/** or classified here with a reason. Run: bun run scripts/skill-coverage.ts (--strict to gate, --json/--all for detail).

skippedPackages.@questpie/admin: covered by the separate questpie-admin skill (audit hook: map it there)
skippedPackages.create-questpie: scaffolder CLI, not a library surface
skippedPackages.@questpie/vite-plugin-iconify: admin build tooling; covered by the questpie-admin skill
